title: Colophon Declaration
description: Operator-authored statement of what one agent may do. Unsigned intent. Becomes a Record via `colophon record build`.

id.description: UUID v4. The all-zero UUID is rejected.

owner.description: Accountable human or team, e.g. an email at the operator's domain.

autonomy_level.description: CSA-style autonomy level. L0: no autonomy, human performs every action. L1: assistive, proposes and a human acts. L2: supervised, acts only on per-action human approval. L3: delegated, acts within declared bounds with a human on the loop. L4: bounded autonomous, acts inside hard constraints, humans engage on exception only. L5: fully autonomous, broad discretion.

data_classes.description: Data classes this tool may touch. Must be a subset of the top-level data_classes.

destinations.description: For tools that send or fetch: allowed destination patterns (glob on address, host, or URL prefix).

data_classes.description: Every data class the agent may touch across all tools, e.g. public, internal, confidential, pii, secret.

write_paths.description: Path prefixes the agent may write under. Any write outside is refused.

max_scopes.description: Upper bound on credential scopes any auth.* tool may request.

review_due.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A Record past this date is stale and fails lint.

a2a_card_uri.description: Optional citation of an A2A Agent Card. Identity only; never a permission source.
